insight: Mureka O1, billed as the first music reasoning model, applies chain-of-thought 'MusiCoT' to composition; by Kunlun Tech's Skywork AI.
name: Mureka
tagline: AI music generator for songs, vocals, and instrumentals from a prompt.
description: An AI music platform that generates original songs, vocals, and instrumentals from text or lyrics, with stem export, voice cloning, and multi-language support. It runs its own in-house models — the Mureka O1 reasoning model and V6 — and exposes an API for developers alongside the web app. The free tier has generation limits; paid tiers add higher quotas and commercial licensing.

changelog.summary: Recategorized from audio to the new dedicated music-generation category.

edge: Runs its own Mureka O1 'music reasoning' model with chain-of-thought composition plus a developer API, unlike most prompt-only generators.
pros: In-house O1 reasoning and V6 models
Developer API, not just a web app
cons: Free tier has tight generation limits
Commercial licensing only on paid tiers
Output quality lags Suno/Udio at top end
